records.statement:
theorem continuous_parameter_intervalIntegral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) :
    Continuous (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s)
records.proof:
by
  have h := continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous (μ := volume) hG
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))
  simpa only [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ] using h
records.comment: Continuity of a compact interval integral, for a continuous joint integrand.

records.statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {D : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] E}
    {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D))
    (hd : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q s) (D p s) p) (p₀ : Parameters) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s) (∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p₀ s) p₀
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall p₀ 1).prod (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hD.continuousOn
  have hGs (p : Parameters) : Continuous (G p) := hG.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hDs (p : Parameters) : Continuous (D p) := hD.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (s := ball p₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => C) (ball_mem_nhds p₀ one_pos)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun p => (hGs p).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((hGs p₀).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ) (hDs p₀).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards [] with s hs
    rw [uIoc_of_le hℓ] at hs
    intro p hp
    exact hC (p, s) ⟨ball_subset_closedBall hp, ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩⟩
  · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  · filter_upwards [] with s _ p _
    exact hd p s
records.comment:
A continuous parameter derivative on a compact rectangle supplies the bound
needed to differentiate the actual interval integral.

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_two_parameter_intervalIntegral
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {G : Parameters → ℝ → E} {D : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] E}
    {D₂ : Parameters → ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] (Parameters →L[ℝ] E)}
    {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry G)) (hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D))
    (hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂))
    (hd : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q s) (D p s) p)
    (hd₂ : ∀ p s, HasFDerivAt (fun q => D q s) (D₂ p s) p) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s)
records.proof:
by
  have h₁ := hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hG hD hd
  have h₂ := hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hD hD₂ hd₂
  have heq : fderiv ℝ (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, G p s) = fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p s :=
    funext fun p => (h₁ p).fderiv
  rw [show (2 : WithTop ENat) = 1 + 1 from rfl, contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv]
  refine ⟨fun p => (h₁ p).differentiableAt, by simp, ?_⟩
  rw [heq, contDiff_one_iff_fderiv]
  refine ⟨fun p => (h₂ p).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  have heq₂ : fderiv ℝ (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D p s) = fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, D₂ p s :=
    funext fun p => (h₂ p).fderiv
  rw [heq₂]
  exact continuous_parameter_intervalIntegral hℓ hD₂
records.comment: Two continuous actual parameter derivatives yield C² of the actual integral.

records.statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters
    {ρ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ρ) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hB : Continuous B)
    (p : Parameters) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ρ (κ s + B s p))
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s) p
records.proof:
by
  have hp : Continuous (fun q : Parameters × ℝ => κ q.2 + B q.2 q.1) :=
    (hκ.comp continuous_snd).add ((hB.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply continuous_fst)
  apply hasFDerivAt_parameter_intervalIntegral
    (G := fun p s => ρ (κ s + B s p))
    (D := fun p s => deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s) hℓ (hρ.continuous.comp hp)
    ((hρ.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  intro p s
  exact (hρ.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
    ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_two_integral_linear_parameters
    {ρ κ : ℝ → ℝ} {B : ℝ → Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ρ) (hκ : Continuous κ) (hB : Continuous B) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, ρ (κ s + B s p))
records.proof:
by
  let D := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) => deriv ρ (κ s + B s p) • B s
  let D₂ := fun (p : Parameters) (s : ℝ) =>
    (deriv (deriv ρ) (κ s + B s p) • B s).smulRight (B s)
  have hp : Continuous (fun q : Parameters × ℝ => κ q.2 + B q.2 q.1) :=
    (hκ.comp continuous_snd).add ((hB.comp continuous_snd).clm_apply continuous_fst)
  have hρ₁ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (deriv ρ) := hρ.deriv'
  have hD : Continuous (Function.uncurry D) :=
    ((hρ₁.continuous.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  have hD₂ : Continuous (Function.uncurry D₂) := by
    dsimp [D₂, Function.uncurry]
    exact (isBoundedBilinearMap_smulRight (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := Parameters)
      (F := Parameters →L[ℝ] ℝ)).continuous.comp
      (((hρ₁.continuous_deriv_one.comp hp).smul (hB.comp continuous_snd)).prodMk
        (hB.comp continuous_snd))
  apply contDiff_two_parameter_intervalIntegral
    (G := fun p s => ρ (κ s + B s p)) (D := D) (D₂ := D₂)
    hℓ (hρ.continuous.comp hp) hD hD₂
  · intro p s
    exact (hρ.differentiable (by norm_num) _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))
  · intro p s
    exact ((hρ₁.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt p
      ((B s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (κ s))).smul_const (B s)

records.statement:
theorem contDiff_endpointParameters {θ η u v : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η)
    (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (endpointParameters θ η u v ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  exact (contDiff_two_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_cos hθ
    (continuous_parameterLinear hη hu hv)).prodMk
    (contDiff_two_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_sin hθ
      (continuous_parameterLinear hη hu hv))

records.statement:
theorem fderiv_endpointParameters_zero {θ η u v : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hθ : Continuous θ) (hη : Continuous η)
    (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v) (p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    fderiv ℝ (endpointParameters θ η u v ℓ) 0 p =
      (p.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η s) +
        p.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * u s) +
        p.2.2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * v s),
       p.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η s) +
        p.2.1 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * u s) +
        p.2.2 * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * v s))
records.proof:
by
  have hB := continuous_parameterLinear hη hu hv
  have hc := hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_cos hθ hB (0 : Parameters)
  have hs := hasFDerivAt_integral_linear_parameters hℓ Real.contDiff_sin hθ hB (0 : Parameters)
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (endpointParameters θ η u v ℓ)
      ((∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s).prod
       (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s)) 0 := by
    convert hc.prodMk hs using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | simp only [map_zero, add_zero, Real.deriv_cos, Real.deriv_sin]
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) p = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply
      (φ := fun s => -sin (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) (μ := volume) (v := p)
      (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg.smul hB).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)]
    simpa only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, Pi.neg_apply] using
      integral_parameterLinear hη hu hv (Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).neg p
  · change (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) p = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply
      (φ := fun s => cos (θ s) • parameterLinear η u v s) (μ := volume) (v := p)
      (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).smul hB).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)]
    simpa only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply] using
      integral_parameterLinear hη hu hv (Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ) p

records.statement:
theorem exists_implicit_correction {f : (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)) → ℝ × ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f)
    (ht : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) = 0)
    (hc : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g 0 ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt g 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, f (t, g t) = f 0
records.proof:
by
  have hi : ((fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ))).IsInvertible := by
    rw [hc]
    exact ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ (ℝ × ℝ), rfl⟩
  let h := hf.contDiffAt (x := (0 : Parameters))
  let g := h.implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi
  refine ⟨g, h.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi,
    h.implicitFunction_apply_self (by norm_num) hi, ?_,
    h.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi⟩
  have hd := h.hasStrictFDerivAt_implicitFunction (by norm_num) hi
  rw [ht] at hd
  simpa using hd.hasFDerivAt.hasDerivAt
records.comment:
Genuine finite-dimensional IFT, specialized to an identity correction block
and a zero tangent block. No solution function is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem exists_exact_endpoint_variation {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0)
    (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hηx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hηy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0) :
    ∃ ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ, ∃ a b : ℝ → ℝ,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0 ∧
      a 0 = 0 ∧ b 0 = 0 ∧ HasDerivAt a 0 0 ∧ HasDerivAt b 0 0 ∧
      ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, hx₁, hy₁, hx₂, hy₂⟩ := exists_normalized_constraint_directions hℓ hθ hne
  let f := endpointParameters θ η.val ξ₁.val ξ₂.val ℓ
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f := contDiff_endpointParameters hℓ.le hθ.continuous
    η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
  have ht : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro t
    change fderiv ℝ f 0 (t, (0, 0)) = (0, 0)
    rw [fderiv_endpointParameters_zero hℓ.le hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous]
    rw [hηx, hηy]
    simp
  have hc : (fderiv ℝ f 0).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (ℝ × ℝ)) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro p
    change fderiv ℝ f 0 (0, p) = p
    rw [fderiv_endpointParameters_zero hℓ.le hθ.continuous
      η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous]
    rw [hx₁, hy₁, hx₂, hy₂]
    simp
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg₀, hgd, hge⟩ := exists_implicit_correction hf ht hc
  refine ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, (fun t => (g t).1), (fun t => (g t).2), hg.fst, hg.snd,
    congrArg Prod.fst hg₀, congrArg Prod.snd hg₀, hgd.fst, hgd.snd, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hge] with t ht
  constructor
  · have hx := congrArg Prod.fst ht
    simpa [f, endpointParameters, parameterLinear_apply, add_assoc] using hx
  · have hy := congrArg Prod.snd ht
    simpa [f, endpointParameters, parameterLinear_apply, add_assoc] using hy
records.comment:
Every linearized feasible C¹ direction at a nonstraight curve is tangent to
an actual C²-parameter family preserving both endpoint positions exactly.
The two correction directions have zero endpoint values by their subtype.

records.proof:
by
  convert (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).mul_const (η s)).const_add (θ s) |>.add
    (ha.mul_const (u s)) |>.add (hb.mul_const (v s))) using 1
  all_goals first | rfl | simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, add_zero]
records.comment: The correction terms vanish to first order, so the realized tangent is η.

records.statement:
theorem corrected_angle_endpoints {θ a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (η u v : variationSpace ℓ) (t : ℝ) :
    (θ 0 + t * η.val 0 + a t * u.val 0 + b t * v.val 0 = θ 0) ∧
    (θ ℓ + t * η.val ℓ + a t * u.val ℓ + b t * v.val ℓ = θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  simp [η.property.2.1, η.property.2.2, u.property.2.1, u.property.2.2,
    v.property.2.1, v.property.2.2]
records.comment: Correction by fixed-end angle variations preserves both prescribed angles.

records.statement:
theorem energy_const (ε : ℝ → ℝ) (α ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun _ => α) ℓ = ℓ * ε 0
records.proof:
by
  simp [energy]
records.comment: A constant tangent angle has zero curvature and constant energy density.

records.statement:
theorem energy_affine (ε : ℝ → ℝ) (α c ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => α + c * s) ℓ = ℓ * ε c
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  simp_rw [show ∀ s : ℝ, deriv (fun u => α + c * u) s = c from
    fun s => curvature_affine α c s]
  simp
records.comment: An affine tangent angle has constant signed curvature, hence this exact energy.

records.statement:
theorem integral_curvature {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv θ s) = θ ℓ - θ 0
records.proof:
by
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub
    (fun s _ => hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s)
    (hθ.continuous_deriv_one.intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ)
records.comment: The linear curvature term integrates to the difference of the lifted end angles.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_energy_affine_fixed_end_variation {ε η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η)
    (h0 : η 0 = 0) (hend : η ℓ = 0) (α c : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation (fun s => α + c * s) η t) ℓ) 0 0
records.proof:
by
  have h := hasDerivAt_energy_variation (θ := fun s => α + c * s) hℓ hε
    (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)) hη
  have hi : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv (fun u => α + c * u) s) * deriv η s) = 0 := by
    simp_rw [show ∀ s : ℝ, deriv (fun u => α + c * u) s = c from
      fun s => curvature_affine α c s]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_curvature hη]
    simp [h0, hend]
  simpa only [hi] using h
records.comment:
Straight lines and circular arcs have zero actual first variation under
fixed-end-angle variations. This proves stationarity, not minimum energy.

records.statement:
theorem energy_affine_density {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hε : Continuous ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) θ ℓ =
      energy ε θ ℓ + a * (θ ℓ - θ 0) + b * ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have he : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => ε (deriv θ s)) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (hε.comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  have ha : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => a * deriv θ s) volume 0 ℓ :=
    (continuous_const.mul hθ.continuous_deriv_one).intervalIntegrable 0 ℓ
  unfold energy
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (he.add ha) intervalIntegrable_const,
    intervalIntegral.integral_add he ha, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    integral_curvature hθ]
  simp [mul_comm]
records.comment: Adding `a κ + b` to the density changes the actual energy only by boundary data.

records.statement:
theorem affine_density_shift_same_end_angles {ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (a b ℓ : ℝ) (h0 : θ 0 = ψ 0) (hℓ : θ ℓ = ψ ℓ) :
    energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) θ ℓ - energy ε θ ℓ =
      energy (fun q => ε q + a * q + b) ψ ℓ - energy ε ψ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_affine_density hε hθ, energy_affine_density hε hψ, h0, hℓ]
  ring
records.comment:
For a fixed angle branch and length, the affine-density correction is the
same for any two curves sharing both lifted endpoint angles.

records.statement:
theorem reflection_counterexample :
    energy (fun q : ℝ => q) (fun s : ℝ => s) 1 = 1 ∧
    energy (fun q : ℝ => q) (fun s : ℝ => -s) 1 = -1
records.proof:
by
  simp [energy]
records.comment: An exact failure of reflection invariance for a density that is not even.

records.statement:
theorem energy_reflection_of_even {ε : ℝ → ℝ} (hε : ∀ q, ε (-q) = ε q)
    (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => -θ s) ℓ = energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  unfold energy
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro s _
  change ε (deriv (fun u => -θ u) s) = ε (deriv θ s)
  rw [show deriv (fun u => -θ u) s = -deriv θ s from deriv.neg]
  exact hε _
records.comment: Evenness of the density is sufficient for reflection invariance of the energy.

records.statement:
theorem energy_rotation (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (α ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε (fun s => θ s + α) ℓ = energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  simp only [energy, deriv_add_const]
records.comment: A rigid rotation adds a constant to the angle and preserves energy for any density.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_pos (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    0 < exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof: exp_pos _

records.statement:
theorem log_exponentialWeight (β : ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    log (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) = -β * energy ε θ ℓ
records.proof: log_exp _

records.statement:
theorem energy_eq_neg_log_exponentialWeight {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ = -log (exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ) / β
records.proof:
by
  rw [log_exponentialWeight]
  field_simp
records.comment: No sign condition on the energy is needed to recover it by a logarithm.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_split {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (β a ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ =
      exponentialWeight β ε θ a * exp (-β * (∫ s in a..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))
records.proof:
by
  have hc := hε.comp hθ.continuous_deriv_one
  have he := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume)
    (hc.intervalIntegrable 0 a) (hc.intervalIntegrable a ℓ)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply] at he
  unfold exponentialWeight energy
  rw [← he, mul_add, exp_add]
records.comment:
Adjacent intervals compose multiplicatively. Oriented integrals make the
identity valid without an ordering hypothesis on the cut.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_split_three {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hε : Continuous ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (β a b ℓ : ℝ) :
    exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ =
      exp (-β * (∫ s in 0..a, ε (deriv θ s))) *
      exp (-β * (∫ s in a..b, ε (deriv θ s))) *
      exp (-β * (∫ s in b..ℓ, ε (deriv θ s)))
records.proof:
by
  rw [exponentialWeight, energy_split_three hε hθ a b ℓ]
  rw [mul_add, mul_add, exp_add, exp_add]
records.comment: The existing three-piece energy decomposition gives three multiplicative factors.

records.statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_le_exp_neg_mul_iff {β x y : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    exp (-β * x) ≤ exp (-β * y) ↔ y ≤ x
records.proof:
by
  rw [exp_le_exp]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

records.statement:
theorem exp_neg_mul_lt_exp_neg_mul_iff {β x y : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) :
    exp (-β * x) < exp (-β * y) ↔ y < x
records.proof:
by
  rw [exp_lt_exp]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

records.statement:
theorem energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ ↔
      exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof: (exp_neg_mul_le_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).symm
records.comment: The same curves are compared, with the order reversed.

records.statement:
theorem energy_lt_iff_exponentialWeight_lt {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (ε θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy ε θ ℓ < energy ε ψ ℓ ↔
      exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ < exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof: (exp_neg_mul_lt_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).symm

records.statement:
theorem energy_minimum_iff_exponentialWeight_maximum {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) (S : Set (ℝ → ℝ)) :
    (∀ ψ ∈ S, energy ε θ ℓ ≤ energy ε ψ ℓ) ↔
      (∀ ψ ∈ S, exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ)
records.proof:
by
  simp only [energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le hβ]
records.comment: Global extrema correspond on any one fixed feasible set.

records.statement:
theorem isLocalMinOn_iff_isLocalMaxOn_exp_neg_mul
    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β)
    (f : α → ℝ) (S : Set α) (x : α) :
    IsLocalMinOn f S x ↔ IsLocalMaxOn (fun y => exp (-β * f y)) S x
records.proof:
by
  change (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[S] x, f x ≤ f y) ↔
    (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[S] x, exp (-β * f y) ≤ exp (-β * f x))
  simp only [exp_neg_mul_le_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ]
records.comment: Local extrema also correspond, including on a restricted feasible set.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_iff_exponentialWeight_local_maximum
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →
        ψ 0 = θ 0 → ψ ℓ = θ ℓ →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (ψ s)) = (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s)) →
        (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
          |ψ s - θ s| < r ∧ |deriv ψ s - deriv θ s| < r) →
        exponentialWeight β ε ψ ℓ ≤ exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  simp only [LocallyMinimizing, energy_le_iff_exponentialWeight_le hβ]
records.comment: The original C¹ constrained neighborhood and boundary conditions are retained.

records.proof:
by
  convert (hf.const_mul (-β)).exp using 1
  ring
records.comment: Chain rule for an actual scalar parameter derivative.

records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have h := (hw.log (exp_ne_zero _)).const_mul (-(β⁻¹))
    simpa only [log_exp, neg_mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hβ, one_mul] using h
  · intro hf
    exact (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf.hasDerivAt).differentiableAt
records.comment: The logarithmic inverse transports actual differentiability back to the energy.

records.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have hf := (differentiableAt_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).mp hw.differentiableAt
    have he := (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf.hasDerivAt).unique hw
    have hd : deriv f x = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp he with h | h
      · exact False.elim ((mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hβ) (exp_ne_zero _)) h)
      · exact h
    simpa only [hd] using hf.hasDerivAt
  · intro hf
    simpa only [mul_zero] using hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf
records.comment: Stationarity equivalence is about actual derivatives, not an assumed formula.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_exp_neg_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)) x = -β * exp (-β * f x) * deriv f x
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x
  · exact (hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf.hasDerivAt).deriv
  · have hw : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => exp (-β * f t)) x :=
      fun h => hf ((differentiableAt_exp_neg_mul_iff hβ).mp h)
    simp only [deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hf,
      deriv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hw, mul_zero]
records.comment:
The total derivative formula also holds where the inner function is not
differentiable: the logarithmic inverse forces both total derivatives to be zero.

records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ]
  simp only [mul_eq_zero, neg_eq_zero, hβ, exp_ne_zero, false_or]

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x d q β : ℝ}
    (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hf : HasDerivAt f d x) (hsecond : HasDerivAt (deriv f) q x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)))
      (β ^ 2 * exp (-β * f x) * d ^ 2 - β * exp (-β * f x) * q) x
records.proof:
by
  have he : deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)) =
      fun t => -β * exp (-β * f t) * deriv f t :=
    funext (deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ)
  rw [he]
  convert ((hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β hf).const_mul (-β)).mul hsecond using 1
  rw [hf.deriv]
  ring
records.comment:
Actual scalar second derivative, requiring only the two stated derivative
facts at the point. The extra square term is retained away from stationarity.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul_of_stationary {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x q β : ℝ}
    (hβ : β ≠ 0) (hf : HasDerivAt f 0 x) (hsecond : HasDerivAt (deriv f) q x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exp (-β * f t)))
      (-β * exp (-β * f x) * q) x
records.proof:
by
  simpa only [zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_mul] using
    hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ hf hsecond
records.comment:
At a stationary point the second derivative changes by the negative factor
`-β * exp (-β * f x)` when `β > 0`. No minimality is assumed.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_exponentialWeight_variation {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) (β : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ)
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hzero : angleVariation θ η 0 = θ := by
    funext s
    simp only [angleVariation, zero_mul, add_zero]
  simpa only [exponentialWeight, hzero] using
    hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul β (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη)
records.comment: The first derivative uses the already proved differentiation of the actual energy.

records.statement:
theorem exponentialWeight_variation_stationary_iff {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) 0 0 ↔
      HasDerivAt (fun t => energy ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ) 0 0
records.proof: hasDerivAt_exp_neg_mul_zero_iff hβ
records.comment: Stationarity along each actual energy variation is unchanged for nonzero `β`.

records.statement:
theorem stationary_iff_exponentialWeight_stationary {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (ε θ : ℝ → ℝ) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    Stationary ε θ ℓ ↔
      ∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
        deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s)) 0 = 0 →
        deriv (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s)) 0 = 0 →
        deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η.val t) ℓ) 0 = 0
records.proof:
by
  simp only [Stationary, exponentialWeight, deriv_exp_neg_mul_eq_zero_iff hβ]
records.comment:
The existing stationarity predicate uses the same fixed-angle directions and
the same two linearized displacement constraints after the change of representation.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exponentialWeight_variation
    {ε θ η : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε)
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ 1 η) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (angleVariation θ η t) ℓ))
      (β ^ 2 * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η s) ^ 2 -
        β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
          (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η s) ^ 2)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hzero : angleVariation θ η 0 = θ := by
    funext s
    simp only [angleVariation, zero_mul, add_zero]
  simpa only [exponentialWeight, hzero] using hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul hβ
    (hasDerivAt_energy_variation hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ hη)
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_energy_variation hℓ hε hθ hη)
records.comment:
The full second derivative along the actual additive angle family. This
family need not preserve endpoint positions; hence the square term is retained.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_exponentialWeight_family_of_stationary
    {ε : ℝ → ℝ} {Θ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ x q β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hfirst : HasDerivAt (fun t => energy ε (Θ t) ℓ) 0 x)
    (hsecond : HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => energy ε (Θ t) ℓ)) q x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε (Θ t) ℓ))
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε (Θ x) ℓ * q) x
records.proof: hasDerivAt_deriv_exp_neg_mul_of_stationary hβ hfirst hsecond
records.comment:
Any actual stationary energy path, in particular an exact admissible family,
has the stated weighted second derivative. The input `hsecond` is a derivative
of the actual energy path, not a separately defined quadratic expression.

records.statement:
theorem constrained_secondVariation_exponentialWeight_corrected
    {ε θ a b : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0)
    (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    (ha : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 a 0) (hb : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) (ha1 : deriv a 0 = 0) (hb1 : deriv b 0 = 0)
    (hx : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s))
    (hy : (fun t => ∫ s in 0..ℓ,
      sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => ∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))
    (hstat : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun t => exponentialWeight β ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ))
      (-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ *
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
          (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2)) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hdx := (hasDerivAt_corrected_integral_and_deriv (ε := cos) hℓ contDiff_cos
    hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
    ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).1
  have hdy := (hasDerivAt_corrected_integral_and_deriv (ε := sin) hℓ contDiff_sin
    hθ.continuous η.property.1.continuous ξ₁.property.1.continuous ξ₂.property.1.continuous
    ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).1
  have hxI : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 := by
    have h := hdx.deriv
    rw [hx.deriv_eq] at h
    simpa only [Real.deriv_cos, deriv_const] using h.symm
  have hyI : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 := by
    have h := hdy.deriv
    rw [hy.deriv_eq] at h
    simpa only [Real.deriv_sin, deriv_const] using h.symm
  have hz : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv η.val s) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hxI, hyI, mul_zero, add_zero] using hstat η
  have he := (hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv hℓ hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁.property.1 ξ₂.property.1 ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1).1
  rw [hz] at he
  have hsecond := constrained_secondVariation_corrected hℓ hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁ ξ₂ ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1 hb1 hx hy hstat
  have h := hasDerivAt_deriv_exponentialWeight_family_of_stationary hβ he hsecond
  simpa only [ha0, hb0, zero_mul, add_zero] using h
records.comment:
On the existing exact constrained corrected family, stationarity removes
both the first-derivative square and the acceleration terms. The constrained
second variation is therefore multiplied by `-β * exponentialWeight β ε θ ℓ`.
The exact displacement hypotheses are used to derive first-order feasibility;
that feasibility is not separately assumed.

records.statement: @[simp] theorem xCoord_zero (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℝ) : xCoord θ x₀ 0 = x₀
records.proof:
by
  simp [xCoord]

records.statement: @[simp] theorem yCoord_zero (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (y₀ : ℝ) : yCoord θ y₀ 0 = y₀
records.proof:
by
  simp [yCoord]

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_xCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (x₀ s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (xCoord θ x₀) (Real.cos (θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  exact (((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt.const_add x₀)

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_yCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (y₀ s : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (yCoord θ y₀) (Real.sin (θ s)) s
records.proof:
by
  exact (((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 s).hasDerivAt.const_add y₀)

records.statement:
theorem deriv_xCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (x₀ s : ℝ) :
    deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s = Real.cos (θ s)
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_xCoord hθ x₀ s).deriv

records.statement:
theorem deriv_yCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (y₀ s : ℝ) :
    deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s = Real.sin (θ s)
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_yCoord hθ y₀ s).deriv

records.statement:
theorem unit_speed_squared {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ) (x₀ y₀ s : ℝ) :
    (deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s)^2 + (deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s)^2 = 1
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_xCoord hθ, deriv_yCoord hθ]
  exact Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq _
records.comment: The reconstructed curve has Euclidean speed one.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_xCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    {κ s : ℝ} (hθ' : HasDerivAt θ κ s) (x₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (xCoord θ x₀)) (-Real.sin (θ s) * κ) s
records.proof:
by
  have hx : deriv (xCoord θ x₀) = fun u => Real.cos (θ u) :=
    funext (deriv_xCoord hθ x₀)
  rw [hx]
  exact hθ'.cos

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_yCoord {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    {κ s : ℝ} (hθ' : HasDerivAt θ κ s) (y₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (yCoord θ y₀)) (Real.cos (θ s) * κ) s
records.proof:
by
  have hy : deriv (yCoord θ y₀) = fun u => Real.sin (θ u) :=
    funext (deriv_yCoord hθ y₀)
  rw [hy]
  exact hθ'.sin

records.statement:
theorem signed_curvature_determinant {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Continuous θ)
    {κ s : ℝ} (hθ' : HasDerivAt θ κ s) (x₀ y₀ : ℝ) :
    deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s * deriv (deriv (yCoord θ y₀)) s -
      deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s * deriv (deriv (xCoord θ x₀)) s = κ
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_xCoord hθ, deriv_yCoord hθ,
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_xCoord hθ hθ' x₀).deriv,
    (hasDerivAt_deriv_yCoord hθ hθ' y₀).deriv]
  calc
    _ = (Real.cos (θ s)^2 + Real.sin (θ s)^2) * κ := by ring
    _ = κ := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]; simp
records.comment: For the unit-speed reconstruction, `x' y'' - y' x'' = θ'`.

records.statement:
theorem signed_curvature_eq_deriv {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : Differentiable ℝ θ)
    (x₀ y₀ s : ℝ) :
    deriv (xCoord θ x₀) s * deriv (deriv (yCoord θ y₀)) s -
      deriv (yCoord θ y₀) s * deriv (deriv (xCoord θ x₀)) s = curvature θ s
records.proof: signed_curvature_determinant hθ.continuous (hθ s).hasDerivAt x₀ y₀

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_const (α x₀ s : ℝ) :
    xCoord (fun _ => α) x₀ s = x₀ + s * Real.cos α
records.proof:
by
  simp [xCoord]
records.comment: A constant angle reconstructs a straight line.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_const (α y₀ s : ℝ) :
    yCoord (fun _ => α) y₀ s = y₀ + s * Real.sin α
records.proof:
by
  simp [yCoord]

records.statement: @[simp] theorem curvature_const (α s : ℝ) : curvature (fun _ => α) s = 0
records.proof:
by
  simp [curvature]

records.statement:
theorem curvature_affine (α κ s : ℝ) :
    curvature (fun u => α + κ * u) s = κ
records.proof:
by
  simp [curvature]
records.comment: The linear angle of a circular arc has the specified constant signed curvature.

records.statement:
theorem xCoord_affine (α κ x₀ s : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) :
    xCoord (fun u => α + κ * u) x₀ s =
      x₀ + (Real.sin (α + κ * s) - Real.sin α) / κ
records.proof:
by
  have hd (u : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun v => Real.sin (α + κ * v) / κ)
        (Real.cos (α + κ * u)) u := by
    simpa [hκ] using
      (((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul κ |>.const_add α).sin.div_const κ)
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s) (fun u _ => hd u)
    ((Real.continuous_cos.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
  unfold xCoord
  rw [hi]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
  ring
records.comment: A nonzero affine angle reconstructs the classical circular arc.

records.statement:
theorem yCoord_affine (α κ y₀ s : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) :
    yCoord (fun u => α + κ * u) y₀ s =
      y₀ + (Real.cos α - Real.cos (α + κ * s)) / κ
records.proof:
by
  have hd (u : ℝ) :
      HasDerivAt (fun v => -Real.cos (α + κ * v) / κ)
        (Real.sin (α + κ * u)) u := by
    simpa [hκ] using
      ((((hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul κ |>.const_add α).cos.neg).div_const κ)
  have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s) (fun u _ => hd u)
    ((Real.continuous_sin.comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))).intervalIntegrable 0 s)
  unfold yCoord
  rw [hi]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
  ring

records.statement:
theorem abs_x_displacement_le (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (x₀ ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    |xCoord θ x₀ ℓ - x₀| ≤ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := ℓ) (C := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun u => Real.cos (θ u))
    (fun u _ => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one (θ u))
  simpa [xCoord, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hℓ] using h
records.comment:
A necessary endpoint condition. In particular an x-displacement greater than
the length cannot be attained, irrespective of tangent boundary conditions.

records.statement:
theorem abs_y_displacement_le (θ : ℝ → ℝ) (y₀ ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    |yCoord θ y₀ ℓ - y₀| ≤ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
    (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := ℓ) (C := (1 : ℝ))
    (f := fun u => Real.sin (θ u))
    (fun u _ => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_sin_le_one (θ u))
  simpa [yCoord, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hℓ] using h

records.statement:
theorem impossible_x_endpoint {x₀ x₁ ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ)
    (hfar : ℓ < |x₁ - x₀|) : ¬ ∃ θ : ℝ → ℝ, xCoord θ x₀ ℓ = x₁
records.proof:
by
  rintro ⟨θ, hθ⟩
  have h := abs_x_displacement_le θ x₀ ℓ hℓ
  rw [hθ] at h
  exact (not_lt_of_ge h) hfar

records.statement:
theorem corrected_family_C1_close {θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ)
    {a b : ℝ → ℝ} (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ,
      |(θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) - θ s| < r ∧
      |deriv (fun u => θ u + t * η.val u + a t * ξ₁.val u + b t * ξ₂.val u) s -
        deriv θ s| < r
records.proof:
by
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    |η.val s| + |deriv η.val s| + |ξ₁.val s| + |deriv ξ₁.val s| +
      |ξ₂.val s| + |deriv ξ₂.val s|
  have hG : Continuous G :=
    ((((η.property.1.continuous.abs.add η.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs).add
      ξ₁.property.1.continuous.abs).add ξ₁.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs).add
        ξ₂.property.1.continuous.abs).add ξ₂.property.1.continuous_deriv_one.abs
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hG.continuousOn
  have hbounds (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ) :
      |η.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv η.val s| ≤ C ∧
      |ξ₁.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv ξ₁.val s| ≤ C ∧
      |ξ₂.val s| ≤ C ∧ |deriv ξ₂.val s| ≤ C := by
    have hg : G s ≤ C := (le_abs_self (G s)).trans (by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC s hs)
    dsimp [G] at hg
    have h₁ := abs_nonneg (η.val s)
    have h₂ := abs_nonneg (deriv η.val s)
    have h₃ := abs_nonneg (ξ₁.val s)
    have h₄ := abs_nonneg (deriv ξ₁.val s)
    have h₅ := abs_nonneg (ξ₂.val s)
    have h₆ := abs_nonneg (deriv ξ₂.val s)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => (|t| + |a t| + |b t|) * C) 0 :=
    ((continuousAt_id.abs.add ha.abs).add hb.abs).mul continuousAt_const
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), (|t| + |a t| + |b t|) * C < r :=
    hcont.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by simpa [ha0, hb0] using hr))
  filter_upwards [hsmall] with t ht
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := hbounds s hs
  have hd : deriv (fun u => θ u + t * η.val u + a t * ξ₁.val u + b t * ξ₂.val u) s =
      deriv θ s + t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s + b t * deriv ξ₂.val s :=
    ((((hθ.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.add
      ((η.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul t)).add
        ((ξ₁.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (a t))).add
          ((ξ₂.property.1.differentiable one_ne_zero s).hasDerivAt.const_mul (b t))).deriv
  constructor
  · have he : θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s - θ s =
        t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact (abs_three_term_bound h₁ h₃ h₅).trans_lt ht
  · rw [hd]
    have he : deriv θ s + t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s +
        b t * deriv ξ₂.val s - deriv θ s =
        t * deriv η.val s + a t * deriv ξ₁.val s + b t * deriv ξ₂.val s := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact (abs_three_term_bound h₂ h₄ h₆).trans_lt ht
records.comment:
A continuous finite-parameter correction tending to zero tends to the base
angle in the C¹ neighborhood on the fixed compact interval.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ)
    (η ξ₁ ξ₂ : variationSpace ℓ) {a b : ℝ → ℝ}
    (ha : ContinuousAt a 0) (hb : ContinuousAt b 0)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s)) ∧
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)) =
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, sin (θ s))) :
    IsLocalMin (fun t => energy ε
      (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s) ℓ) 0
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hminimal⟩ := hmin
  have hclose := corrected_family_C1_close hθ η ξ₁ ξ₂ ha hb ha0 hb0 hr
  change ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ),
    energy ε (fun s => θ s + 0 * η.val s + a 0 * ξ₁.val s + b 0 * ξ₂.val s) ℓ ≤ _
  simp only [ha0, hb0, zero_mul, add_zero]
  filter_upwards [hclose, hexact] with t ht hx
  apply hminimal (fun s => θ s + t * η.val s + a t * ξ₁.val s + b t * ξ₂.val s)
  · exact ((hθ.add (contDiff_const.mul η.property.1)).add
      (contDiff_const.mul ξ₁.property.1)).add (contDiff_const.mul ξ₂.property.1)
  · simp only [η.property.2.1, ξ₁.property.2.1, ξ₂.property.2.1, mul_zero, add_zero]
  · simp only [η.property.2.2, ξ₁.property.2.2, ξ₂.property.2.2, mul_zero, add_zero]
  · exact hx.1
  · exact hx.2
  · exact ht
records.comment:
A C¹ local minimum of the constrained energy induces a scalar local minimum
on every exact corrected family with continuous coefficients vanishing at zero.
The hypotheses from a C² implicit-function correction are therefore sufficient.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_stationary_of_nonstraight {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) : Stationary ε θ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  apply (stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ).mpr
  intro η hx hy
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, a, b, ha, hb, ha0, hb0, ha1, hb1, hexact⟩ :=
    exists_exact_endpoint_variation hℓ hθ hne η hx hy
  have hm := locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family hθ hmin η ξ₁ ξ₂
    ha.continuousAt hb.continuousAt ha0 hb0 hexact
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv hℓ.le hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁.property.1 ξ₂.property.1 ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1.deriv hb1.deriv).1
  exact hd.deriv.symm.trans hm.deriv_eq_zero
records.comment:
A genuine C¹ local minimum at a nonstraight curve satisfies the original
stationarity predicate, which is stated using actual parameter derivatives.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_angle_firstIntegral_curvature
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ, ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s =
        -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
      (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
        lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
      (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
        (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
        deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  exact stationary_angle_firstIntegral_curvature hℓ hε hθ
    (locallyMinimizing_stationary_of_nonstraight hℓ (hε.of_le (by norm_num)) hθ1
      (exists_nonzero_curvature_of_nonconstant hℓ hθ1 hne) hmin)
records.comment:
The existing angle, first-integral and curvature equations now follow
from a true constrained local minimum; no stationarity hypothesis is supplied.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_secondVariation_nonneg
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ lam μ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (hne : ∃ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ, deriv θ s ≠ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ)
    (hm : ∀ ζ : variationSpace ℓ,
      (∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv ε (deriv θ s) * deriv ζ.val s) +
        lam * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * ζ.val s) +
        μ * (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * ζ.val s) = 0)
    (η : variationSpace ℓ)
    (hx : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0)
    (hy : (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0) :
    0 ≤ ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
      (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2
records.proof:
by
  obtain ⟨ξ₁, ξ₂, a, b, ha, hb, ha0, hb0, ha1, hb1, hexact⟩ :=
    exists_exact_endpoint_variation hℓ hθ hne η hx hy
  have hpath := locallyMinimizing_isLocalMin_corrected_family hθ hmin η ξ₁ ξ₂
    ha.continuousAt hb.continuousAt ha0 hb0 hexact
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_corrected_energy_and_deriv hℓ.le hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁.property.1 ξ₂.property.1 ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1.deriv hb1.deriv).1
  have hsecond := constrained_secondVariation_corrected hℓ.le hε hθ η.property.1
    ξ₁ ξ₂ ha hb ha0 hb0 ha1.deriv hb1.deriv
    (hexact.mono fun _ h => h.1) (hexact.mono fun _ h => h.2) hm
  exact second_derivative_nonneg_of_local_min hpath hd.continuousAt hsecond
records.comment:
Every linearized feasible direction at a nonstraight local minimum has
nonnegative constrained second variation, for any stationary multipliers.

records.statement:
theorem locallyMinimizing_necessary_conditions
    {ε θ : ℝ → ℝ} {ℓ : ℝ}
    (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) (hε : ContDiff ℝ 3 ε) (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 3 θ)
    (hne : ¬ ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 ℓ, θ s = θ 0)
    (hmin : LocallyMinimizing ε θ ℓ) :
    ∃ lam μ σ : ℝ,
      (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
        (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s =
          -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s)) ∧
        (deriv θ s * deriv ε (deriv θ s) - ε (deriv θ s) -
          lam * cos (θ s) - μ * sin (θ s) = σ) ∧
        (deriv (deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t))) s +
          (deriv θ s) ^ 2 * deriv ε (deriv θ s) -
          deriv θ s * ε (deriv θ s) - σ * deriv θ s = 0)) ∧
      (∀ η : variationSpace ℓ,
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, -sin (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        (∫ s in 0..ℓ, cos (θ s) * η.val s) = 0 →
        0 ≤ ∫ s in 0..ℓ, deriv (deriv ε) (deriv θ s) * (deriv η.val s)^2 -
          (lam * cos (θ s) + μ * sin (θ s)) * (η.val s)^2)
records.proof:
by
  have hθ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ := hθ.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hε1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 ε := hε.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hε2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 ε := hε.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hn := exists_nonzero_curvature_of_nonconstant hℓ hθ1 hne
  have hstat := locallyMinimizing_stationary_of_nonstraight hℓ hε2 hθ1 hn hmin
  have hM : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) :=
    (hε.deriv' (n := 2)).comp (hθ.deriv' (n := 2))
  obtain ⟨lam, μ, hm⟩ := stationary_multipliers hθ.continuous hM.continuous
    ((stationary_iff_firstVariation hℓ.le hε1 hθ1).mp hstat)
  have hAngle : ∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 ℓ,
      deriv (fun t => deriv ε (deriv θ t)) s = -lam * sin (θ s) + μ * cos (θ s) := by
    apply residual_zero_of_augmented_stationary hℓ hM
      ((contDiff_const.mul hθ1.sin).add (contDiff_const.mul hθ1.cos))
    intro η
    rw [force_integral hθ.continuous η]
    linarith [hm η]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := smooth_angle_firstIntegral_and_curvature hθ hε hAngle
  refine ⟨lam, μ, σ, (fun s hs => ⟨hAngle s hs, hσ s hs⟩), ?_⟩
  exact locallyMinimizing_secondVariation_nonneg hℓ hε2 hθ1 hn hmin hm
records.comment:
Complete necessary-condition theorem. A nonstraight C¹ constrained local
minimum with the original C³ data has one choice of multipliers that satisfies
all three classical equations and the constrained second-variation inequality.
Neither stationarity, exact variation realization, nor rank is assumed.

records.statement: @[simp] theorem powerLog_zero (z : ℝ) : powerLog 0 z = log z
records.proof:
by
  simp [powerLog]

records.statement: @[simp] theorem powerLog_one (p : ℝ) : powerLog p 1 = 0
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0 <;> simp [powerLog, hp]

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_powerLog {p z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    HasDerivAt (powerLog p) (z ^ (p - 1)) z
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    unfold powerLog
    simpa [Real.rpow_neg_one] using Real.hasDerivAt_log hz.ne'
  · unfold powerLog
    simp only [hp, ite_false]
    convert ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := p) (Or.inl hz.ne')).sub_const 1).div_const p using 1
    field_simp
records.comment: Every exponent gives the same first-order normalization at `z = 1`.

records.statement:
theorem deriv_powerLog {p z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    deriv (powerLog p) z = z ^ (p - 1)
records.proof: (hasDerivAt_powerLog hz).deriv

records.statement:
theorem deriv_powerLog_pos {p z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    0 < deriv (powerLog p) z
records.proof:
by
  rw [deriv_powerLog hz]
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hz _

records.statement:
theorem powerLog_mul (p : ℝ) {z w : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (hw : 0 < w) :
    powerLog p (z * w) = powerLog p z + powerLog p w + p * powerLog p z * powerLog p w
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp [powerLog, Real.log_mul hz.ne' hw.ne']
  · simp only [powerLog, hp, ite_false]
    rw [Real.mul_rpow hz.le hw.le]
    field_simp
    ring
records.comment:
The exact transported multiplication law; at exponent zero it is logarithmic
additivity. This identity is not an identification of two empirical response laws.

records.statement:
theorem continuousAt_powerLog_exponent_zero {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p => powerLog p z) 0
records.proof:
by
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun p : ℝ => z ^ p) (log z) 0 := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) z).rpow (hasDerivAt_id 0) hz
  convert hd.continuousAt_div using 1
  funext p
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp [powerLog]
  · simp [powerLog, hp]
records.comment:
The normalized power response really tends to the logarithm as its exponent
tends to zero, including the explicitly defined value at zero.

records.statement:
theorem tendsto_powerLog_exponent_zero {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    Tendsto (fun p => powerLog p z) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (log z))
records.proof:
by
  simpa using (continuousAt_powerLog_exponent_zero hz).tendsto

records.statement:
@[simp] theorem powerLogDensity_zero (K κ₀ κ : ℝ) :
    powerLogDensity 0 K κ₀ κ = K * (κ * log (κ / κ₀) - κ + κ₀)
records.proof:
by
  simp [powerLogDensity]

records.statement:
@[simp] theorem powerLogDensity_neg_one (K κ₀ κ : ℝ) :
    powerLogDensity (-1) K κ₀ κ = K * (κ - κ₀ - κ₀ * log (κ / κ₀))
records.proof:
by
  norm_num [powerLogDensity]

records.statement:
theorem powerLogDensity_reference (p K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) :
    powerLogDensity p K κ₀ κ₀ = 0
records.proof:
by
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp [powerLogDensity, hp, hκ₀.ne']
  · by_cases hp' : p = -1 <;> simp [powerLogDensity, hp, hp', hκ₀.ne']

by
  unfold powerLogDensity
  have hz : 0 < κ / κ₀ := div_pos hκ hκ₀
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · subst p
    simp only [powerLog_zero]
    convert ((((hasDerivAt_id κ).mul (hasDerivAt_log_ratio hκ₀ hκ)).sub
      (hasDerivAt_id κ)).add_const κ₀).const_mul K using 1
    all_goals dsimp
    field_simp; ring
  · by_cases hp' : p = -1
    · subst p
      simp only [show (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num, ite_false]
      convert (((hasDerivAt_id κ).sub_const κ₀).sub
        ((hasDerivAt_log_ratio hκ₀ hκ).const_mul κ₀)).const_mul K using 1
      all_goals first | rfl | (simp only [powerLog, ite_eq_right hp, Real.rpow_neg_one, inv_div]; ring)
    · have hp1 : p + 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hp'; linarith
      simp only [hp, hp', ite_false, powerLog]
      have hd := ((((hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const κ₀).rpow_const
        (p := p + 1) (Or.inl hz.ne')).sub_const 1).div_const (p + 1)
      convert (hd.sub (((hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const κ₀).sub_const 1)).const_mul
        (K * κ₀ / p) using 1
      all_goals dsimp
      rw [show p + 1 - 1 = p by ring]
      field_simp
records.comment:
Actual differentiation of the displayed potential, including both exceptional
exponents.  The response formula is proved, not supplied as a hypothesis.

records.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_powerLogDensity (p K : ℝ) {κ₀ κ : ℝ}
    (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (hκ : 0 < κ) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (powerLogDensity p K κ₀))
      (K / κ₀ * (κ / κ₀) ^ (p - 1)) κ
records.proof:
by
  have he : deriv (powerLogDensity p K κ₀) =ᶠ[𝓝 κ]
      fun q => K * powerLog p (q / κ₀) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds hκ] with q hq
    exact (hasDerivAt_powerLogDensity p K hκ₀ hq).deriv
  have hd := ((hasDerivAt_powerLog (p := p) (div_pos hκ hκ₀)).comp κ
    ((hasDerivAt_id κ).div_const κ₀)).const_mul K
  have hd' : HasDerivAt (fun q => K * powerLog p (q / κ₀))
      (K / κ₀ * (κ / κ₀) ^ (p - 1)) κ := by
    convert hd using 1
    all_goals first | rfl | ring
  exact hd'.congr_of_eventuallyEq he
records.comment:
The actual second derivative of the potential remains positive for every
real response exponent when the reference curvature and scale are positive.

records.proof:
by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_deriv_powerLogDensity p K hκ₀ hκ).deriv]
  exact mul_pos (div_pos hK hκ₀) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos hκ hκ₀) _)

records.statement:
theorem powerLogDensity_one (K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (κ : ℝ) :
    powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀ κ = (K / κ₀) * κ ^ 2 / 2 - K * κ + K * κ₀ / 2
records.proof:
by
  norm_num [powerLogDensity, Real.rpow_two]
  field_simp; ring
records.comment:
Exponent one recovers a classical quadratic density plus an affine term.
This polynomial identity extends to all signed curvatures.

records.statement:
theorem energy_powerLogDensity_one {θ : ℝ → ℝ} (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ)
    (K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ =
      energy (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ -
        K * (θ ℓ - θ 0) + K * κ₀ / 2 * ℓ
records.proof:
by
  have he : powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀ =
      fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2 + (-K) * q + K * κ₀ / 2 := by
    funext q
    rw [powerLogDensity_one K hκ₀]
    ring
  rw [he, energy_affine_density (by fun_prop) hθ]
  ring
records.comment:
The affine part changes the actual curve energy only by the fixed lifted
endpoint angles and length, using the existing affine-density integral theorem.

records.statement:
theorem energy_powerLogDensity_one_le_iff {θ ψ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hθ : ContDiff ℝ 1 θ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ)
    (K : ℝ) {κ₀ : ℝ} (hκ₀ : 0 < κ₀) (ℓ : ℝ)
    (h0 : θ 0 = ψ 0) (hend : θ ℓ = ψ ℓ) :
    energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) θ ℓ ≤ energy (powerLogDensity 1 K κ₀) ψ ℓ ↔
      energy (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) θ ℓ ≤
        energy (fun q => (K / κ₀) * q ^ 2 / 2) ψ ℓ
records.proof:
by
  rw [energy_powerLogDensity_one hθ K hκ₀,
    energy_powerLogDensity_one hψ K hκ₀, h0, hend]
  exact add_le_add_iff_right _ |>.trans (sub_le_sub_iff_right _)
records.comment:
On fixed endpoint-angle data, exponent one compares curves in exactly the
same order as the classical quadratic bending energy.
